text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting to Master. Diagnostic result: 
"Damage: Minor."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The probability is low, but... if the 
power is successfully controlled, I judge 
the subject will be in a condition capable 
of exercise."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Requesting permission to continue 
training. No matter how low the 
probability, I will make it a success."
choice_data_list: I'm worried, so let's get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Requesting permission to continue 
training. No matter how low the 
probability, I will make it a success."
choice_data_list: I'm worried, so let's get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Worry... is it...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Order understood. I apologize for 
causing you concern.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating Operation: "Resting to Avoid 
Causing Worry."

And so, Mihono Bourbon took time to heal 
her injury...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing Operation: 'Control 
Power and Continue Training.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Factoring in damaged components. 
Throttling power output.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start halfway, at 50% 
output...!
(Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh! Checking the pain... in the 
affected area...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am... sorry. Even at 50% output... it 
seems to have provided stimulation.

Deciding that any form of exercise would 
only make things worse, you have her rest 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No pain... Output at 50%, clear. Next 
is... 55%—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting to Master. Verification shows an 
output capacity of up to 65%.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I propose restructuring the regimen based 
on this data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Whatever the training regimen may 
be, I will carry it out without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of Master, who believed I 
could maintain control and gave me the 
command.

Having successfully mastered control of 
her power, Mihono Bourbon tackled her 
restructured regimen with diligence... and 
made a swift return to the track!
